_meta.note: Source strings. Other files are machine-translated from this one (pnpm --filter web translate).

hintPasskey: You'll confirm with your email or a passkey. Nothing to install.
hintEmail: You'll confirm with your email. Nothing to install.
invalidBody: Open the full link from your email. If it still doesn't work, ask the sender to send it again.
loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
claimedTitle: This payment has already been claimed
claimedBody: {amount} from {platform} was claimed with this link.
errAlreadyClaimed: This payment has already been claimed.
errDifferentEmail: This payment was sent to a different email. Sign out, then sign in with the email address it was sent to.
errSession: Your session has expired. Sign in again to claim.
errExpired: This link has expired. Ask the sender to send it again.
errOffline: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errInvalid: This link isn't valid. Ask the sender to send it again.
errGeneric: Something went wrong and nothing was claimed. Try again in a moment.
emailStillWaiting: {platform} sent you {amount}, and it's still waiting for you.
emailSignIn: Sign in with this email address to receive it. It takes about a minute.
emailClaimBy: Claim it by {date}. After that, the money goes back to {platform}.
emailOnlyForYou: This link is only for you. Don't forward it.
emailFooter: Fanout sends payouts for platforms. You didn't expect this? You can ignore this email.
